frame.name: Wave Sword Frame
frame.description:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.

origins.name: Willing Vessel
origins.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

origins.name: Runneth Over
origins.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

perks.name: Energy Transfer
perks.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.

enhanced.name: Energy Transfer
enhanced.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy at an improved rate.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.name: Slice
enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

enhanced.name: Relentless Strikes
enhanced.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.description: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

enhanced.name: Duelist's Trance
enhanced.description: Sword final blows grant greatly increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.

enhanced.name: Valiant Charge
enhanced.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.

enhanced.name: Flash Counter
enhanced.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets for an improved period of time.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: En Garde
perks.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this sword do additional damage.

enhanced.name: En Garde
enhanced.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

enhanced.name: Redirection
enhanced.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.
